children: Consumer prices in Sweden rose by 0.3% year-on-year in August 2026, falling short of market expectations for a 0.6% gain but slightly above the 0.2% increase recorded in the previous month, which was the lowest reading since May 2025, according to preliminary estimates. “Preliminary figures show a slightly higher inflation rate according to the CPI,” said Caroline Neander, price statistician at Statistics Sweden.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices fell by 0.3%, the same pace as in the preceding period.
Meanwhile, the CPI with a fixed interest rate (CPIF), the Riksbank’s target measure, rose 0.7% in August, unchanged from the prior month but slightly below the expected 0.8% gain.

title: Sweden Inflation Rises Less Than Expected
